ENGLAND.label: Ingland
ENGLAND.description: Statutary non-domestic ratin unner Local Government Finance Act 1988 and Non-Domestic Rating Act 2023.

WALES.label: Wales
WALES.description: Devolved non-domestic ratin unner Local Government Finance (Wales) Act 2024 and WSI statutory instruments.

SCOTLAND.label: Scotland
SCOTLAND.description: Devolved non-domestic ratin unner Non-Domestic Rates (Scotland) Act 2020. Three-tier multiplier seestem an Small Business Bonus Scheme.

CORPORATE.label: Corporate Body / Ltd
CORPORATE.description: Leevemit company (Ltd/PLC/LLP) liable for statutary non-domestic rates.

INDIVIDUAL.label: Individual / Sole Trader
INDIVIDUAL.description: Naitural body, single trader, or unincorporatit partnership.

CHARITY.label: Registratit Chairity
CHARITY.description: Chairity registratit wi OSCR/CC entitlit tae 80% mandatar relief unner statute.

CASC.label: CASC (Community Amateur Sports Club)
CASC.description: HMRC-registered CASC eligible fer 80% mandatory relief.

LOCAL_AUTHORITY.label: Local Authority / Cooncil
LOCAL_AUTHORITY.description: Billin authority, municipal cooncil, or statutory public body.

OCCUPIED.label: Occupyit (Fou)
OCCUPIED.description: Hereditament is actively occupyit for commercial purposes.

UNOCCUPIED.label: Tuim / Unoccupyit
UNOCCUPIED.description: Hereditament is tuim (empty rates relief an statutory liability applies).

PART_OCCUPIED.label: Pairt-Occupyit (s.44A)
PART_OCCUPIED.description: Hereditament is temporarily pairt-tuim, subject tae statutory apportionment.

SBBS.label: Small Business Bonus Scheme (Scotland)
SBBS.description: Scots rates relief for wee businesses up tae £12,000/£11,500 RV.

SBRR.label: Small Business Rate Relief (Ingland)
SBRR.description: 100% discoont up tae £12k RV; linear taper tae £15k RV for single-proaperty occupiers.

CHARITY.label: Mandatar Chairitable Relief
CHARITY.description: 80% mandatar relief unner LGFA 1988 / LGA(S) 1962 s.4 for chairitable uiss.

WALES_SBRR.label: Small Business Rate Relief (Wales)
WALES_SBRR.description: 100% relief up tae £6,000 RV, wi linear taper up tae £12,000 RV (bairn-care 100% tae £100,000 RV; post office 100%/50%) unner LGFA 1988 Sched 4ZA para 4 / W.S.I. 2017/1229.

RHL.label: Retail, Hospitality & Leisure Relief
RHL.description: Statutory sector discount (40% in England 2025/26, expired 2026/27; 15% in Wales 2026/27; 15% mainland / 100% islands in Scotland 2026/27 up to £110,000 cash cap).

IMPROV.label: Improvement Relief (G-Factor)
IMPROV.description: 100% relief for 12 months on rateable value increases resulting from physical property improvements under NDRA 2023 (England).

EMPTY.label: Empty Property Exemption
EMPTY.description: 100% relief for initial 3 months (commercial) or 6 months (industrial) unoccupied periods under LGFA 1988 s.45.

RURAL.label: Rural Settlement Relief
RURAL.description: 100% mandatory relief for sole general stores, food shops, or post offices in designated rural settlements.

LAVATORY.label: Public Lavatories Relief
LAVATORY.description: 100% statutory rating exemption under Rating (Coronavirus and Public Lavatories) Act 2021.

HEAT_NET.label: Heat Network Relief
HEAT_NET.description: 100% relief for low-carbon district heating distribution hereditaments under NDRA 2023 (England).

WELSH_AVOIDANCE.label: Anti-Avoidance Statutory Penalty
WELSH_AVOIDANCE.description: Statutory penalty under Welsh Statutory Instrument 2026/43 (£500 fixed + 3% rateable value) for artificial avoidance.

SBBS_TR.label: Small Business Bonus Scheme Transitional Relief
SBBS_TR.description: Scottish statutory protection capping net bill increases for properties losing or seeing reduced SBBS (£600 in 2023/24 to £1,800 in 2025/26; 25% bill increase limit in 2026/27).

SSBR.label: Supporting Small Business Relief
SSBR.description: English statutory protection capping net bill increases for properties losing or seeing reduced SBRR, rural rate relief, or RHL relief (£600 annual increase cap in 2023–2025; £800 annual increase cap in 2026/27).

WALES_TR.label: Welsh Transitional Relief
WALES_TR.description: Statutory two-year transitional phasing scheme under W.S.I. 2025/1371 / W.S.I. 2022/1350 (67% relief on bill increases > £300 in Year 1, 34% in Year 2).

TELECOM.label: Telecommunications Infrastructure Relief
TELECOM.description: 100% statutory relief for new fibre telecommunications infrastructure under Telecommunications Infrastructure Act 2018 / SSI 2019/111.

CHARITY_TOPUP.label: Discretionary Charitable Relief Top-Up
CHARITY_TOPUP.description: Up to 20% discretionary top-up relief by billing authorities under LGFA 1988 s.47(2)(a) / 1962 Act s.4(5).

RENEWABLE.label: Renewable Energy Generation Relief
RENEWABLE.description: Tiered relief for renewable energy generation hereditaments under SSI 2010/336 (100% up to £145k RV, scaling to 10% up to £1m RV).

COUNCIL_TAX_TRANSFER.label: Council Tax Transfer (Holiday Let Disqualification)
COUNCIL_TAX_TRANSFER.description: Disqualification from non-domestic rating list where self-catering accommodation fails the statutory letting days test (Scotland from 2022/23: 70 days let, 140 available; Wales from 2023/24: 182 let, 252 available; England: 70 let, 140 available).

003.label: 003 - Airport / Major Aviation Infrastructure
003.description: Airport / high-value complex requiring standard national multiplier. Explicitly excluded from small business relief.

091.label: 091 - General Offices / Commercial Premises
091.description: Standard commercial office accommodation. Entitled to 3 months 100% empty property relief.

096.label: 096 - Industrial Hereditament / Warehouse / Factory
096.description: Industrial property qualifying for 6 months 100% empty property exemption under S.I. 2008/386.

209.label: 209 - Public House / Bar / Licensed Premises
209.description: Licensed premises eligible for Retail, Hospitality & Leisure (RHL) relief schemes.

211.label: 211 - Petrol Filling Station & Forecourt
211.description: Automotive fuel sales and forecourt shop. Explicitly excluded from retail discount in Wales under 2026/27 rules.

225.label: 225 - Retail Shop / High Street Unit
225.description: Standard retail shop or store eligible for SBRR and RHL discount schemes.

249.label: 249 - Self-Catering Holiday Accommodation
249.description: Holiday let subject to statutory minimum letting criteria (minimum 70 actual days let / 140 days available in Scotland).

084.label: 084 - Day Nursery / Crèche / Registered Bairn-Care
084.description: Premises hail used for bairn-care eligible for 100% SBRR up tae £100,000 RV in Wales unner W.S.I. 2017/1229 airt. 8.

227.label: 227 - Post Office
227.description: Post office premises eligible for 100% SBRR up tae £9,000 RV an 50% relief up tae £12,000 RV in Wales unner W.S.I. 2017/1229 airt. 9.

024.label: 024 - Beach Hut
024.description: Beach hut. Exeemed explicitly frae Welsh sma business rates relief unner W.S.I. 2017/1229 airt. 2.

050.label: 050 - Caur Pairk (Surface / Multi-Storey)
050.description: Vehicle pairkin premises. Exeemed explicitly frae Welsh sma business rates relief unner W.S.I. 2017/1229 airt. 2.

027.label: 027 - Bettin Office / Bookies
027.description: Bettin premises. Expleecitly excludit frae the Scots Sma Business Bonus Scheme (SBBS) unner SSI 2023/30 reg. 3(5).

SMALL_BUSINESS.label: Smaa Business Multiplier
SMALL_BUSINESS.description: Reduced multiplier fer qualifyin smaa businesses.

HIGH_VALUE.label: Heich-Value Multiplier
HIGH_VALUE.description: Heicher ratin multiplier fer heich-value properties (e.g. RV >= £500,000 in England).

SMALL_BUSINESS_RHL.label: Smaa Business RHL Multiplier
SMALL_BUSINESS_RHL.description: Permanent reduced multiplier fer qualifyin retail, hospitality, leisure unner £51k RV in England.

STANDARD_RHL.label: Standard RHL Multiplier
STANDARD_RHL.description: Permanent reduced multiplier fer qualifyin retail, hospitality, leisure £51k-£500k RV in England.

RETAIL.label: Welsh Retail Multiplier
RETAIL.description: Lawer statutary multiplier fer smaa retail premises unner £51k RV in Wales unner LGF(W)A 2024 (35.0p in 2026/27).

HIGHER.label: Heicher Multiplier (Scotland / Wales)
HIGHER.description: Heicher statutary multiplier fer properties exceedin £100k RV in Scotland and Wales.

BASIC.label: Basic Property Rate
BASIC.description: Baseline non-domestic rate fer properties up tae £51,000 RV in Scotland unner Non-Domestic Rates (Scotland) Act 2020.

INTERMEDIATE.label: Intermediate Property Rate
INTERMEDIATE.description: Intermediate property rate fer properties £51,001 tae £100,000 RV in Scotland unner Non-Domestic Rates (Scotland) Act 2020.

RETAIL_PROVISIONAL.label: Welsh Retail Multiplier (Provisional)
RETAIL_PROVISIONAL.description: Provisional lawer statutary multiplier fer smaa retail premises unner £51k RV in Wales fer 2027/28.

STANDARD_PROVISIONAL.label: Standard Multiplier (Provisional)
STANDARD_PROVISIONAL.description: Provisional baseline non-domestic ratin multiplier fer 2027/28.

HIGHER_PROVISIONAL.label: Heicher Multiplier (Wales, Provisional)
HIGHER_PROVISIONAL.description: Provisional heicher statutary multiplier fer properties exceedin £100k RV in Wales fer 2027/28.
